content:
maria: Kicking off SCL (Santiago) GPU region bring-up. Goal: provision initial cluster for a 2-week validation window, then hand off to capacity. Need quota request + reservation plan. Who can own the GCP quota ticket?

tony: I can own the quota ticket. What's the target size and timing?

maria: Start small but realistic: 8x A100-80GB equivalent GPUs, 2 control VMs, 1 bastion. Request private peering and nodepools with GPU taints. Target start: 2026-04-10. Ticket template below.

maria: ```
Cloud: GCP (southamerica-east1 / SCL)
Project: redwood-scl-bringup
Requested quotas:
- GPUs: 8 x A100-80GB (accelerator count)
- CPUs: 128 cores
- Memory: 768 GB
- Persistent SSD: 4 TB
- Network throughput increase (per-VPC): 10 Gbps
Start window: 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC
Duration: 14 days
Justification: infra bring-up + perf validation for Redwood Dedicated pilot in SCL.
Contacts: tony@redwood.com, maria@redwood.com
Notes: include request for private peering + routing tags (scl-bringup, redwood-gpu).
```

tonny: (typo) Tony: Ticket looks good, I'll open it now.

samir: Ballpark cost for 8xA100-80GB for 2 weeks (on-demand equiv): ~$140k. With short-term commit / reserved window we might get down to ~$95k. Exact numbers after the procurement quote. Need finance signoff.

maria: Added cost center in the ticket template. Also need regional ops and security signoff for private peering and KMS usage.

jin: Quick heads-up — during EU pilot we ran into an MTU mismatch on the VPN/backhaul which tanked throughput. Recommend MTU and jumbo-frame validation as part of bring-up (test both 1500 and 9000 path). Also validate path MTU across peering and any transit.

maria: Good catch. Test steps below. Add to runbook.

maria: ```
# basic perf / mtu tests
# on node A (internal)
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y iperf3
iperf3 -s

# on node B
iperf3 -c <nodeA_internal_ip> -P 10 -t 60

# MTU check
sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000 || true
ping -M do -s 8972 <other_node_internal_ip>

# quick traceroute to peer
traceroute -w 2 -q 2 <peer_ip>
```

infra-bot: quota-ticket-1848010001 created in GCP quota console (https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?project=redwood-scl&ticket=1848010001) :thumbsup:

tony: Ticket opened (1848010001). I'll paste updates here when approvals arrive.

maria: Once quotas are approved, bring-up sequence (high-level):
1) Create VPC + subnet + private peering (OPS + NET)
2) Provision nodepool with GPU taints: redwood:gpu=true:NoSchedule
3) Attach PVs and SSDs, mount under /mnt/gpu-work
4) Deploy benchmark image and perf harness (bench-runner)
5) Run smoke tests: iperf, small transformer inference (50 samples), KV cache sanity
6) Monitor node health for 48h (nodeReady >= 95%) and p50 latency <= 120ms for inference API
7) Create cost dashboard, enable 1h retention metrics, tag resources with cost center
8) Handoff doc + postmortem to capacity team

maria: Handoff criteria: quotas approved, perf targets met, network validated, security checklist (KMS + audit logs) green.

jin: For routing/fallback: add a routing tag 'scl-fallback=west3' so policy engine can route to west3 if capacity falls below threshold. Also confirm cross-region egress costs in the ticket so finance is aware.

samir: Noted on egress. I'll run a quick cost sim and drop numbers into the ticket comments. Approvers we need ping: finance-approvers, security-ops, net-ops. I'll ping them once ticket is in.

maria: Assigning roles: Tony = quota + GCP ops lead, Jin = networking lead, Samir = cost & approvers, Maria = runbook owner + validation lead.

tonny: Tony: On it. Will update here with ticket events. :rocket:

maria: Plan to run validation starting 2026-04-12. We'll try to keep the cluster for 14 days then shrink/reserve based on results. Please post any pre-reqs you need in this thread.

jin: One more: ensure we have a bastion with dual-homed NICs (public + private) for remote debugging; RBAC limited to oncall + owners.

maria: Added to runbook.

infra-bot: Reminder: please attach runbook doc to the ticket and link the SLO/playbook doc: https://confluence.redwood.internal/scl-bringup (placeholder).

samir: I'll follow up with finance and share the procurement PO template.

maria: Great. Thanks everyone — Tony, file the ticket and ping back when approvals come in. We'll use this thread for status updates. :white_check_mark:
